verdict.rationale: Keycloak is self-hosted/deployable via Docker, containers, or the Operator on any infrastructure the operator chooses, which implicitly lets an organization control where data resides by picking the deployment region themselves. However, no evidence explicitly documents data residency, region selection, or compliance-oriented deployment guidance as a feature — this is an inference from generic deployment docs rather than a stated capability. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency documentation, multi-region deployment guidance, or compliance certifications tied to data locality.
